claims.evidence: PRIDE organism NEWT:10090; mouse kidney cortex in paper
Title/protocol: mouse kidney cortex tissue; paper: kidney cortex homogenates

Supp Methods: 'Male C57Bl6/J mice (Janvier) of 10-12 weeks of age'; Methods: 12-week-old mice. Applied to the proteomics cohort (cohort 2) on the basis that all animals were male C57BL/6J; cohort 2 sex not restated separately

claims.value: normal potassium diet / high potassium diet, 4 or 21 days
claims.evidence: NS/NK = 1.05% K+ 0.3% Na+ control; NS/HK = NS/+KCl 5.25% K+; short-term = 4 days (Set1), chronic = 21 days (Set2)

Sheet '4 Days' columns: Ctrl, 5x NS/NK, 5x NS/HK = 11 columns; msf1 TMTpro quant method has exactly 11 active tags 126-131C. Assignment of columns to channels in increasing channel order is INFERRED, not stated
Sheet '21 Days' columns: Ctrl, 7x NS/NK, 5x NS/HK = 13 columns; msf2 method has all 18 tags active so it does not corroborate; first 13 channels in order is INFERRED
'Ctrl' column is 100 for every protein (normalisation reference); nature (pool vs sample) not documented
WorkflowInputFiles: F1..F8 plain-name files acquired first, F1..F8 timestamp-suffixed files re-acquired ~24 h later, all searched together; paper: high pH fractionation
PRIDE MS:1002416; msf WorkflowInputFiles instrument 'Orbitrap Fusion'; protocol: Tribrid Fusion
Sequest/Mascot enzyme 'Trypsin (Full)', 2 missed cleavages. Digestion enzyme not named in PRIDE text or Supp Methods (FASP 'as described (9)'); reconcile flags this

claims.value: Carbamidomethyl C, TMTpro K and N-term (fixed); Oxidation M, Acetyl protein N-term (variable)
claims.evidence: Sequest node StaticModification/DynamicModification values; matches PRIDE data processing protocol
Quantification node ActivationTypeFilter = HCD; raw method not read
Shotgun proteomics, PD workflow; DDA not stated verbatim

limitations: TMT channel to sample assignment is inferred from spreadsheet column order; no deposited file states it explicitly
Nature of the 'Ctrl' channel (pooled reference vs control sample) undocumented
Digestion enzyme (trypsin) taken from search settings, not from sample-preparation text
Sex/strain/age taken from general Methods, not restated for the proteomics cohort
characteristics[treatment] values have no matching NCIT/EFO term (validator warning)
